overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Planning Board's approved minutes accurately recorded the motion and 3-2 vote on both the Site Plan and Special Permit applications, so the complaint was resolved and closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the January 27, 2011 minutes and Certificate of Action misstated the motion and vote on a Site Plan Review and Special Permit application.
allegations.key_passage: We fmd that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law because the final minutes approved by the Board accurately described the action the Board believed it had taken during the meeting.
